name: Joshua Tree National Park
state_or_region: California (Joshua Tree National Park — Mojave & Colorado deserts)
agency: National Park Service, USGS 3DEP & OpenStreetMap Contributors
summary: The whole park where the Mojave meets the Colorado Desert: Joshua tree forests, granite boulder piles, fan-palm oases, the Little San Bernardino Mountains and the wide Pinto Basin. No water in the park's backcountry — carry at least a gallon per person per day.
